name: Chris "Rated X" Xavior
caption: A self-described 'sexiest man in wrestling' who debuts in the CWWO in March 1999 with a promo and a cinema interview in which he promises to make an example of Adrenalin Rush.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id hTc6TEwowK4J, 28 March 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/aol-rper-a-rp-read-it-and-give-me-feedback-1999-03-28.html. The promo promises belts and a takeover; in the scene writer Billy Coe finds him with two women at a showing of Pulp Fiction, and he says he wants Corporate as a stable, respects Outlaw and is not scared of Shawn Christopher. The CWWO is the held wing named by the roleplay.
